args.sql:
WITH article_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.catlabel AS article_category,
        t1.difflevel AS complexity_level,
        -- Calculate ARS using the formula provided
        (
            t1.readsec * LOG(t1.wordlen) / 
            CASE 
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Basic' THEN 1
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Intermediate' THEN 1.5
                WHEN t1.difflevel = 'Advanced' THEN 2
                ELSE 1.2
            END
        ) AS ars,
        -- Extract engagement rate from the JSONB column
        (t1.engagement_metrics->>'engagement_rate')::NUMERIC AS engagement_rate
    FROM 
        articles AS t1
),
average_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        AVG(ars) AS avg_ars,
        AVG(engagement_rate) AS avg_engagement_rate
    FROM 
        article_metrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category
),
complexity_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        article_category,
        complexity_level,
        COUNT(*) AS article_count
    FROM 
        article_metrics
    GROUP BY 
        article_category, complexity_level
),
correlation_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        am.article_category,
        CORR(am.ars, am.engagement_rate) AS correlation_coefficient
    FROM 
        article_metrics AS am
    GROUP BY 
        am.article_category
)
SELECT 
    am.article_category,
    am.avg_ars,
    am.avg_engagement_rate,
    cm.correlation_coefficient,
    cc.complexity_level,
    cc.article_count
FROM 
    average_metrics AS am
JOIN 
    correlation_metrics AS cm ON am.article_category = cm.article_category
JOIN 
    complexity_counts AS cc ON am.article_category = cc.article_category
ORDER BY 
    am.article_category;
